entries.message: has an <a> item without href, which is not a link: it takes no focus and no key activates it.
entries.fix: Give the link an href, or write the item as <button>.

entries.message: opens as a context menu with no trigger to name it, and its menu has no aria-label or aria-labelledby, so a screen reader announces an unnamed menu.
entries.fix: Give the slot="menu" container an aria-label.

entries.message: has no direct child marked slot="menu", so there are no items to wire and nothing opens.
entries.fix: Put the items in one container, such as <div slot="menu">.

entries.message: has opener="context" but no direct child marked slot="target", so no context menu opens it. The menu never takes the native context menu of an element it was not given.
entries.fix: Mark the element whose context menu opens the menu slot="target".

entries.message: has no direct child marked slot="trigger", so nothing opens the menu.
entries.fix: Add <button slot="trigger">, or set opener="context" and mark the element whose context menu opens it slot="target".
